title: Clearer personal learning, progress and Arabic guidance
summary: Show enrolled or started courses, resume lessons directly, and show saved course progress with clear next actions.

changes.detail: My learning now uses the personal course filter instead of showing the full catalogue.
Direct start/resume buttons, saved-plan progress, learning-journey and lesson-list actions, and due/upcoming review labels.
Clear Arabic review guidance, localized study minutes, and explicit remove-from-plan button text. Unenrolling preserves completed lessons.
